# Bragende stærkt regnskab puster liv i aktierne - skal du med på bølgen?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode recorded at the start of Q4 2026, with Saxo strategist Oscar Bernhardsen and Bankinvest chief strategist Jacob Vejlø. The discussion centred on Micron's very strong results (revenue up 380%, EPS up 1000%) renewing the AI theme, and on whether rising US yields (10-year near 5.3%), high AI valuations and debt-funded data-centre capex are risks. Jacob is constructive: overweight equities, US tech/growth, Nvidia, AMD and Intel, and he expects rates to fall in 2027. Oscar's head is optimistic but his gut is cautious: he avoids memory-chip makers because of the pricing boom and suggests bonds as a hedge.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ MU — Micron Technology | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Oscar (guest) avoids memory-chip makers despite record results, because of an unsustainable RAM price boom and new capacity coming.

#### Reasoning

RAM spot prices rose tenfold in a year with the same technology. New fabs, including Micron's two, will add supply. If prices return to historical norms (90% lower), earnings collapse in 3-4 years. The low P/E reflects that uncertainty. Jacob (guest) holds market weight only. This is guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI memory demand proves structurally durable after new capacity comes online
- if RAM prices stay elevated as supply grows

> *"Altså lige med de der memory chips, der vil jeg simpelthen være for bange for, at med det samme er kapacitetsudfordringerne, ikke er et problem mere."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Jacob (Bankinvest) is clearly overweight Nvidia. He sees AI infrastructure as the backbone of a fourth industrial revolution, at about 19-20x forward P/E.

#### Reasoning

Jacob prefers infrastructure over language-model applications because the winners among models are unclear. Nvidia's valuation is not stretched relative to its growth. Oscar is sceptical that the USD 1 trillion yearly revenue expectation will be met. Guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex falls back
- if AI pricing turns into commodity price competition that hurts returns
- if US yields keep rising

> *"For eksempel Nvidia, der jo kæmper med Apple om at være verdens største børsorterede virksomhed."*

---

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Listed by Jacob among the chip names Bankinvest is overweight in its global portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Part of Bankinvest's tilt toward AI infrastructure and tech growth. Only mentioned briefly, with no stock-specific thesis. Guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI infrastructure spending slows

> *"AMD, Intel, så vi ligger i en global aktieportefølje, og er overvægtet af nogle af de her aktører."*

---

### 🟢 INTC — Intel | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Listed by Jacob among the chip names Bankinvest is overweight.

#### Reasoning

Part of Bankinvest's tilt toward AI infrastructure. Only mentioned briefly, with no stock-specific thesis. Guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI infrastructure spending slows

> *"AMD, Intel, så vi ligger i en global aktieportefølje, og er overvægtet af nogle af de her aktører."*

---

### ⛔ 005930.KS — Samsung | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Oscar extends his avoid view to all three memory-chip makers.

#### Reasoning

The same memory price-boom thesis as for Micron: unsustainable prices and new capacity coming. Samsung was only named in passing. Guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices stay high as capacity is added

> *"også de sydkoreanske med Samsung og SK Hynix, Micron, det er ligesom de tre, der står for det der."*

---

### ⛔ 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Oscar extends his avoid view to all three memory-chip makers.

#### Reasoning

Memory pricing is cyclical, and the current boom may reverse as supply is added. SK Hynix was only named in passing. Guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices stay high as capacity is added

> *"også de sydkoreanske med Samsung og SK Hynix, Micron, det er ligesom de tre, der står for det der."*
